scope_notes.thm:finite-bare-hardness: Whole source theorem checked: strict and weak comparison of actual values and actual norms are Pi01-complete on literal positive exponential expressions of depth at most two, with arbitrary finite ground-name arity and original admissible substitutions. Every RE complement has a total computable reduction whose outputs are uniformly genuine source instances. Exact invalid-code handling and positive-tuple counterexample search prove the co-RE upper bound. Positive finite values, norm equality, and membership in every C_i for i>=1 are retained.
scope_notes.thm:bounded-bare-vectors: Whole source theorem checked for both original WW orders. Every RE complement has a total computable reduction to the literal (H,V+1)/(H,U)/(H+1,U) family; all outputs are genuine bounded C-vectors of exactly two components with finite depth-two higher components. Strict order remains strict at zero and weak at positive components. Undecidability excludes even total Boolean procedures required to be correct only on those certified valid inputs.
